Eva hopes to visit Xi'an one day. Mia is interested in drawing. They took many photos at the family dinner table. She spread butter on the toast.

Eva thinks English is interesting but a little difficult. There are always many people at the family dinner table. Mia's birthday is in October. What's more, the wedding hosted the whole extended family.
Both of them like noodles and milk. Eva borrowed a book about English from the bookstore. The spring market is one of the best places in the city. The pear is ripe and ready to eat.
Eva and Mia had great fun there. Eva plays football with Mia every Sunday. The weather was cloudy that day.
